notes:
• Clearing notifications is now animated, in both macOS and Windows mode. With "Clear All", the notifications slide out to the right one after another from the top, the list shrinks smoothly and "No Notifications" fades in. Closing a single notification or a whole app group with × works the same way. The panel no longer jumps or flashes, and tapping "Clear All" twice doesn't clear twice.
• "Clear All" now works like HyperOS: notifications that can't be dismissed stay in the list. Those notifications no longer show a × button, and a notification that the system didn't remove comes back right away instead of staying hidden.
• Uses less memory while the screen is off again. The desktop picture is released after a minute with the screen off, as it was before 2.18.12.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
